<div class="card-body">
'''Golan Laser Battery''' is a [[Light]] [[Weapon]] ([[Artillery Weapon]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ゴラン・レーザー砲塔</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">屋外の惑星位置に配備する。移動不可。同じ場所にいる自分の戦士が、２フォース消費して同じか隣接する位置にいる目標に対して起動できる。運命数を引く。ビークルには運命数＞回避値で命中する。キャラクターには運命数＋１＞能力値で命中する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Golan-Laser-Battery-PSA-160326801.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ゴラン・アームズＤＦ．９対人砲塔の改造型。制御装置を擁する円形の塔はプロトン・シールドで守られており、その上部に旋回するレーザー砲塔が１門以上付いている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Golan laser turret.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on an exterior planet site. Cannot be moved. Your warrior at the same location may fire at a target at the same or an adjacent location, using 2 Force. Draw destiny. A vehicle is hit if destiny > maneuver. A character is hit if destiny +1 > ability.

'''Lore:'''
A modified Golan Arms DF.9 anti-personnel turret. The round tower that holds the controls is proton-shielded, and one or more rotating laser turrets sit on top.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese hits vehicles on destiny > maneuver and characters on destiny +1 > ability; the English uses armor or maneuver, and destiny +2.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Golan Laser Battery]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
